items.title: The right adjoint of the fibre product functor on module categories
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the right adjoint of the functor from modules over the fibre product of rings to triples of modules over the two rings matched over the common quotient, and checks that composing the two functors is the identity on the triple category. The proof obtains the adjointness from a more general adjunction statement, and derives the two identifications expressing that the composition is the identity by rewriting the base changes of the constructed module as base changes along the intermediate ring, reducing them to the corresponding assertions of the earlier fibre product statement.
